fiducials.table_frame: Tags 0-5 and the head camera are given in the measured rectangle (rectangle.description), which rectangle.robot_offsets and rectangle.yaw_deg place relative to the robot: measuring those moves the tags and the camera together. Every label there lies flat, text end toward the robot, edges square to the rectangle. Tags 6 and 7 are on the bucket's walls and follow the bucket. A tag may also be given in the table frame (origin at the table top's near-left outer corner, x right along the near edge, y away from the robot; table (x, y) is base (c - x, -d - y), (c, -d) that corner from table.center and table.size)

family.source: claude/table-fiducial-labels, scripts/fiducials/make_tag_labels.py: the ArUco labels printed for this table, 2026-10-17

square.source: user 2026-10-18: the black square measures 43.18 mm by calipers and the 10 mm scale arms exactly 10 mm, so the print is at scale (the generator's 6 cells of 85 dots at 300 dpi). The head camera's fit to the taped rectangle suggested 42.2-42.4 mm; the user puts that 2% down to hand placement and the tape, acceptable for first tests

label_size.source: the generator's 696 x 847 dot label at 300 dpi (across, along the tape), printed at scale (user 2026-10-18, calipers on the square). The tape's unprinted white margins (about 1.5 mm at the sides and 2.5-3 mm at the ends, so the cut label is about 62 x 77 mm with the tag centre about 45 mm from its text end and 32 mm from its far end) are not drawn

tag_offset.source: the generator puts the tag centre 75.5 dots (6.39 mm) from the label's centre toward its far end, printed at scale (user 2026-10-18, calipers on the square)

rectangle.description: Tags 0-3 mark the corners of a rectangle the user taped on 2026-10-18, measured over the outer corners of their black squares. Its frame: origin at the outer near-left corner of tag 0's square, x along the near side toward tag 1, y toward tag 3 (away from the robot), z up

The corners are the black squares': the head camera (2026-10-18 03:25Z, D435 colour intrinsics) fits them at 0.75 px RMS against 3.59 px for the labels' corners
